intro: Our Upmods Flowr makes storage feel serene. With a floral headboard and ample underbed storage, it blends design with utility—no compromise, all comfort.

features.title: A strong foundation you can count on
features.text: Crafted from engineered wood, our frame delivers dependable support and timeless design — blending strength and style seamlessly.

features.title: Nature-inspired elegance for your space
features.text: Our beautifully carved floral headboard brings artistic detail and natural beauty into your bedroom — delicate, expressive, and made to stand out.

features.title: Box storage that lifts with ease
features.text: Designed with a lift-up mechanism, our underbed storage helps you keep things tidy and within reach — without bending, shifting, or searching. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Texture that soothes and settles
features.text: The wood grain matte finish adds a subtle, natural warmth — giving your room a soft, relaxed feel that encourages calm and comfort.

features.title: A headboard that stays lovely for longer
features.text: Protected with a scratch-resistant foil, your headboard keeps its detail and finish intact through daily life, ensuring it looks just as lovely over time.

name: Upmods Flowr King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
